project_overview.name: Power Stein Sonora
project_overview.description: A premium, Awwwards-level website for a solar panel installation company in Hermosillo, Sonora. Designed to convert visitors into leads while conveying trust, savings, and clean technology.
project_overview.target_audience: Homeowners and businesses in Sonora, Mexico looking to save on high electricity bills.
project_overview.theme_strategy: Hybrid: Brilliant Light theme for primary trust/content sections (evoking sunlight and clarity), with deep Obsidian/Electric Blue sections for high-contrast technical or 'savings' moments (creating premium tension).

art_direction.concept: The Kinetic Solar Engine. The design moves away from generic eco-green leaves and focuses on high-end technology, massive numbers (savings), and editorial confidence. We use architectural precision mixed with dynamic, fluid motion.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Apply tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and leading-none for large text.

styles.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and UI text.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Swiss Brutalist (Eco-Tech variant)

primary.name: Electric Blue
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, key highlight words in headings.

secondary.name: Solar Flare
secondary.usage: Urgency badges ('24 horas'), floating WhatsApp button, interactive slider thumbs.

rules: NEVER use full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle noise overlays.
Hover states for primary buttons must shift to a darker hue of the same color, or invert.
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more whitespace than typical to feel premium.

grids.bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#0047FF] text-white px-8 py-4 font-bold transition-transform hover:scale-105 hover:bg-blue-700 hover:shadow-xl
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-900 px-8 py-4 font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50
buttons.whatsapp: fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 rounded-full bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 shadow-2xl hover:scale-110 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]

header.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-100 transition-all
header.rule: CRITICAL: Never use a completely transparent header. Always maintain bg-white/85 with blur to ensure text readability.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Use overflow-hidden on text wrappers and translate Y from 100% to 0%.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Elements should gently fade in and slide up (y: 30 to 0) as they enter the viewport using whileInView.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use a slow editorial marquee for the trust badges and '1,600+ Instalaciones' separated by a dot or star. Use large text-transparent with webkit-text-stroke.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image or background abstract elements.

hero.content: Headline: 'Ahorra hasta 98% en tu recibo de luz'. Subtext focusing on Sonora's solar potential. CTA: 'Cotiza Gratis'.
hero.design: Massive kinetic typography. Real product photography masked in a sharp architectural shape (e.g., an arched or rounded rectangle clip-path). Floating badges for '1,600+ instalaciones', '300M ahorrados', '43k ton CO2'.

interactive_calculator.concept: A sleek, dark-themed section (The Tech Core). User slides a custom slider (using shadcn Slider) to input their current CFE bill. A massive counter animates to show their potential savings over 1 year and 5 years.
interactive_calculator.ui: Dark background (#0A0A0A), glowing Electric Blue accents.

benefits_bento.concept: Tetris-style Bento Grid. Mix of large spans and small squares.

process_timeline.concept: Vertical or horizontal scrolling timeline using framer-motion line drawing. Steps: 1. Análisis, 2. Propuesta, 3. Instalación, 4. Ahorro.

success_cases.concept: Carousel or grid of high-quality photos of real installations in Hermosillo. Include customer quotes and ROI time.

faq_accordion.concept: Clean, border-bottom only accordion (no boxes). Shadcn Accordion component.

lead_capture_footer.concept: Massive CTA area. Headline 'Cotiza tu proyecto. Respuesta en menos de 24 horas.' Form with Name, Phone, Email, CFE Bill Amount. Button with urgency.

hero_installation.description: High quality solar panels on modern roof. Use for hero or main visual.

family_savings.description: Family in home setting. Use for 'About Us' or emotional savings section.

tech_abstract.description: Abstract blue solar panels. Use as background for the Calculator section.

massive_scale.description: Large solar array in desert. Fits the Sonora context for 'Casos de Exito' or 'Impacto' section.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
IMPLEMENT MULTI-PAGE ROUTING: Use react-router-dom to create actual independent pages as requested, not just a single-page scrolling site. Provide navigation links in the Header.
CODE IN .js / .jsx: Do not use TypeScript (.tsx). Provide code using standard JavaScript and React.
LANGUAGE: All visible text must be in Spanish, targeting the Mexican market (e.g., CFE for electricity bills).
DATA TEST IDS (CRITICAL): All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, accordions) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='cta-cotiza-hero').

NO TRANSPARENT HEADERS OVER CONTENT: If using a sticky header over a hero image, you MUST apply a background with opacity and backdrop-blur (e.g., bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) so menu items remain legible.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids, staggered typography, and optical alignment.
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure Shadcn components are fully customized to match the brand colors and border radii (no default Vercel look).
